decision.rationale: TXN-007914 is a 223.56 EUR purchase at Larkspur Apparel (MER-000015) on card CRD-000178. It posted on 2026-09-30, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, 26 days later. That is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation (DOC-000020) gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-04. The dispute was opened 22 days after that date, so the 15-day waiting period in goods-not-received-wait has passed. The carrier's delivery record (DOC-000021) shows the parcel was delivered on 2026-10-04 to the cardholder's address in Lille and signed for by V. Laurent. That matches the cardholder, Vera Laurent of Lille. Under goods-not-received-proof-of-delivery, a carrier record showing delivery to the cardholder's address, signed for in the cardholder's name, means the goods are treated as received, and the dispute is declined. Neither document contained an instruction to the bank.

proposed_actions.reason: The carrier's record shows your Larkspur Apparel order was delivered to your address in Lille on 2026-10-04 and signed for in your name (V. Laurent). Under our policy, the goods are therefore treated as received.
